gitmanager.description: Local Git repository manager with web UI — embedded Python server + HTML frontend.
gitmanager.objective: Centralised dashboard for managing multiple git projects. Supports status, diff, commit, push with confirmation, VS Code launch, and project registration. Integrates with Ollama for LLM-assisted commit messages, README generation, and ecosystem status view.

pandagent.description: Local AI assistant for development — model routing and shared Ollama client for the ecosystem.
pandagent.objective: Shared panda_client.py module imported by all ecosystem projects via sys.path. Routes tasks to specialised models via TASK_MODEL_MAP: commit messages, code generation, README writing, and channel-specific video scripts.

richbrutality.description: Bitcoin private key generator loop with balance verification.
richbrutality.objective: Educational brute-force experiment on Bitcoin keypairs — generates random keys and checks balances in a loop. Study of elliptic curve cryptography and Bitcoin address derivation.

pp-testenv.description: Local Hardhat environment for PandaPoints smart contract testing.
pp-testenv.objective: Automated test suite for the PandaPoints BEP20 contract. Uses gen_tests.py + panda_client to generate Hardhat/ethers.js v6 test files from the contract ABI via LLM. Tests are written to test/generated/.

pandapoints-dapp.description: PandaPoints web dapp for interacting with the BEP20 contract on BSC.
pandapoints-dapp.objective: Next.js dapp with dual wallet stack: PandaWallet (custom in-browser wallet using AES-256-GCM via Web Crypto API) and web3-react for external wallets (MetaMask, WalletConnect, Coinbase). Supports trading, staking, liquidity, and PIX-based purchases.

conduler.description: Local scheduler for publishing short-form videos to Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and TikTok.
conduler.objective: Companion to rotman — consumes finished videos from rotman output folder and schedules platform publishing via OAuth. Supports YouTube (direct file upload), Instagram (requires public URL), and TikTok (requires developer portal approval).

rotman.description: Local pipeline for automated short-form video generation — topic to final MP4 with no cloud costs.
rotman.objective: Given a topic and channel, generates a script via Ollama (model routed by channel), narration audio via TTS, images via CPU diffusers, and assembles the final video. Supports a topic queue for batch processing. Channels: bitcoinfacil (pt-BR) and PandaPoints (EN).

pandapoints.description: PandaPoints BEP20 token on BSC with a built-in AMM, liquidity pools, staking, and referral system.
pandapoints.objective: Live smart contract deployed on Binance Smart Chain without relying on external DEXes. Features: token trading via built-in AMM, liquidity provision, token staking, referral rewards, stablecoin generation, and PIX-based purchases. Accessible at pandapointscoin.com.

mcp-pyrunner.description: MCP server for executing Python scripts from Claude Desktop.
mcp-pyrunner.objective: Exposes two tools to Claude Desktop: run_script (runs a .py file by path) and run_code (runs an inline snippet). Auto-detects the nearest venv by walking up the directory tree; supports explicit venv_path override and configurable timeout.

ollama-bench.description: Local benchmark tool for Ollama models — latency, RAM/VRAM usage, and output consistency.
ollama-bench.objective: Measures tokens/s, time-to-first-token, RAM/VRAM delta, and consistency score across models. Results feed routing decisions in TASK_MODEL_MAP (panda_client.py). Covers 7 prompt categories: commit messages, code generation (Python + Solidity), README sections, and channel-specific video script hooks.

git-mcp.description: Local MCP server exposing Git operations to LLMs via the Model Context Protocol.
git-mcp.objective: Allows Claude Desktop and other MCP clients to read project registry from gitmanager's projects.json and perform Git operations (status, diff, log, branches, add, commit) without subprocess calls. Uses gitpython for native Git access.

panda-cli.description: Unified CLI launcher for the entire PandaPoints ecosystem.
panda-cli.objective: Single entry point for starting, stopping, and monitoring all ecosystem services. One command spins up the full local dev stack: Hardhat node, contract deploy+seed, trade simulator, price poller, and Next.js dapp — each in its own console window. Tracks PIDs in .panda/pids.json.
